verdict.rationale: Rainforest documents agent-usable surfaces: an OpenAPI 3.1.0 spec of its API, an llms.txt index with markdown-fetchable pages, and server API keys. Its money-side resources include deposits, configurable via the Update merchant endpoint, with webhooks for deposit events and for every status change in a chargeback's lifecycle. However, the pack never shows endpoints for reading balances or listing payouts, a way to investigate a missing deposit, or submitting dispute evidence via API. The probe's 404s at guessed OpenAPI paths do not contradict the documented spec. Missing for 10: documented balance/payout read endpoints, a missing-payout investigation workflow, an API surface for drafting or submitting dispute evidence, and hands-on corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can work the money side — read balances and payouts, investigate a seller's missing payout, draft dispute evidence — against documented, agent-usable surfaces

citations.quote: Rainforest supports OpenAPI Specifications (OAS) of the Rainforest API, version 3.1.0.
Append .md to any documentation page URL to get it
For **Active** merchants, the deposit frequency can be updated by setting the new deposit frequency on the [Update merchant](https://docs.rainforestpay.com/reference/update_merchant) endpoint.
Configure Rainforest to send webhook notifications for any payment, merchant, or deposit events
Webhooks can be configured to receive updates on every status change that occurs through the lifecycle of a chargeback.
